question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose optional `SandboxFsBridge.appendFile` as the capability contract for native agent-write append on authoritative sandbox backends?
rationale: This is a new public Plugin SDK capability, so source review can establish that the proposed implementation is coherent but cannot choose the long-term supported backend and compatibility policy without owner intent.

options.title: Accept the capability-gated contract
options.body: Adopt optional `appendFile` for authoritative backends, preserve OpenShell omission, and document that uncertain append outcomes must not be retried automatically.

options.title: Keep append internal for now
options.body: Do not extend the Plugin SDK until maintainers define a different shared sandbox filesystem API or support policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the capability-gated contract
recommendation.body: Adopt optional `appendFile` for authoritative backends, preserve OpenShell omission, and document that uncertain append outcomes must not be retried automatically.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review timeline explicitly routed the unresolved append-contract decision to steipete.
